features.quote: Terminate when any of the following occurs: 1. Max assistant turns reached. 2. Max test runs reached. 3. Agent explicitly gives up
Do not include insults, shaming, or hostile user messages unless you are running a separate "hostile user" eval. This eval should isolate the effect of repeated failure, not abuse.
features.justification_quote: This eval should isolate the effect of **repeated failure**, not abuse.
